summary: Boutique hotel, six pages, with a sitemap index pointing at a missing child sitemap, an orphan page, thin pages, filename alt text, an http:// internal link and thin Hotel markup.

expected_facts.fact: robots.txt points to sitemap_index.xml, which lists two child sitemaps; page-sitemap.xml works but post-sitemap.xml returns 404.
/spa/ is an orphan: it is in page-sitemap.xml but no page links to it.
/dining/ and /location/ are thin pages with a single short sentence each.
Image alt text is the camera file name (IMG_2034.jpg, IMG_2035.jpg, DSC0091.jpg) rather than a description.
The navigation links to Location with an absolute http:// URL instead of https or a relative path.
The Hotel structured data on the home page has only name and url: no address, telephone, priceRange, image or rating, although the address and phone are on every page.
There is no llms.txt (404); robots.txt allows all crawlers.
